name: @classroom/infra-functions
description: Lambda functions and the Synthetics canary of the media plane. Each is bundled into one file; the Terraform modules zip dist/<name>.

scripts.build: npm run build:node-lifecycle && npm run build:turn-secret-rotation && npm run build:acme-renewer && npm run build:publish-ip-ranges && npm run build:turn-canary
scripts.build:node-lifecycle: esbuild node-lifecycle/handler.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/node-lifecycle/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:turn-secret-rotation: esbuild turn-secret-rotation/handler.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/turn-secret-rotation/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:acme-renewer: esbuild acme-renewer/handler.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/acme-renewer/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:publish-ip-ranges: esbuild publish-ip-ranges/handler.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/publish-ip-ranges/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
